findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: list_economies, get_chokepoints, get_products · Destructive: get_sectors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: list_economies, get_chokepoints, get_products · Destructive: get_sectors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_weekly_pulse" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Weekly Economic Pulse: weekly economic activity index (momentum gauge from high-frequency data such as electricity demand, freight, travel, card spending, jobless claims and job postings; standard deviations from average 13-week growth, 0 = average, not a GDP forecast). Omit economy for the latest r" → after: "Weekly Economic Pulse: weekly economic activity index (momentum gauge from high-frequency data such as electricity demand, freight, travel, card spending, jobless claims and job postings; standard deviations from average 13-week growth, 0 = average, not a GDP forecast). Omit economy for the latest r"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
